# ADR 0002: Staging and newer-wins upserts

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** KYB legal entity lookup service

## Context

Full files and deltas overlap; reads must never see a half-loaded table.

## Decision

Load into staging with COPY, then INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (lei) DO UPDATE WHERE excluded.last_update > lei_record.last_update, in batches.

## Consequences

Repeatable loads; reads continue during imports.

## Alternatives considered

Truncate-and-reload (downtime).
